items.t: 3 Nuclear Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching After The X Energy SMR Approval
items.sum: Nuclear power just crossed an important line into the factory gate, with regulators signing off on X-energy’s Xe-100 small modular reactors for Dow’s Seadrift site. That decision pulls advanced nuclear out of the theory bucket and into real-world industrial use, and investors often prefer not to watch a potential multi decade story from the sidelines.
